title: Triase email masuk
description: Salinan preset "email" Laya: arahkan email ke tim yang tepat, deteksi spam/phishing, nilai urgensi, dan tandai risiko churn serta permintaan refund. Isi from/subject di state tambahan agar hasilnya lebih akurat.

category.instructions: Which team should handle the email in `body`?

is_spam.instructions: Is this email unsolicited spam or bulk marketing?

is_phishing.instructions: Is this email a phishing or scam attempt to steal money, credentials, or personal data?

urgency.instructions: How urgent is the request in `body`?

needs_reply.instructions: Does the sender expect a reply?

churn_risk.instructions: Does the email suggest the customer may leave or cancel?

refund_requested.instructions: Does the customer ask for money back?
